summary: Implementation plan to elevate the BNHS Pickleball Club platform's aesthetic and interactivity with Broadcast Varsity Arena court-inspired styling, interactive 3D-tilt Varsity Player Cards, live court diagrams with real-time win-probability bars, animated Elo rank-up and streak celebrations, optional Web Audio scoreboard sound effects and live spectator ticker, Weekly MVP voting & club polls, and an interactive Club Activity Feed with player reactions.
